article.story: MACOMB, Ill. -- — Cameron Wallace's 16 points helped Little Rock defeat Western Illinois 77-58 on Thursday. Wallace had nine rebounds for the Trojans (10-16, 7-8 Ohio Valley Conference). Truman Claytor IV went 6 of 13 from the field (2 for 4 from 3-point range) to add 16 points. Braxton Bayless had 14 points and shot 5 for 5, including 3 for 3 from beyond the arc. The Trojans broke a six-game losing streak. Lucas Lorenzen led the Leathernecks (5-22, 1-15) in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Western Illinois also got 11 points and six rebounds from Isaiah Griffin. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
